## Declarations and implementations

```plato

    // Luminance <-> a raw amount in candelas per square meter.
    Amount(x: Luminance): Number => x.CandelasPerSquareMeter;
    FromAmount(_: Luminance, x: Number): Luminance => new Luminance(x);

    // Irradiance <-> a raw amount in watts per square meter.
    Amount(x: Irradiance): Number => x.WattsPerSquareMeter;
    FromAmount(_: Irradiance, x: Number): Irradiance => new Irradiance(x);

    //==
    // # IQuantity types declared outside the `quantities-*.plato` files
    //
    // `Duration` (`time.types.plato`) is the fiftieth `IQuantity` implementor. Its pair
    // lives here rather than in a time library because the pattern is one thing and
    // should be read in one place; `time.library.plato` is the natural home to move
    // it to if the projection set grows.

    // Duration <-> a raw amount in seconds.
    Amount(x: Duration): Number => x.Seconds;
    FromAmount(_: Duration, x: Number): Duration => new Duration(x);
}
```
